Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin encourages Simon to write a frank email in 'Un-send!', then in 'The Orb', when Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the "No-Buddy".

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin suffers another implausible miscommunication in 'Party Animals', and then in 'Warren Seville', Theodore invents a new imaginary friend.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Theodore gives Dave an ugly handmade vest in 'The Gift', and then in 'Theo Knows Best', when Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has ideas on how the money should be spent.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers in 'Sister Act', then in 'Lil' T', Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a mega-hit.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies in 'Members Only', then in 'The New Kid', Alvin befriends a lonely new kidl, but the new student may not be who he says he is.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but must keep the puppy hidden from Dave in 'Dog Days', then in 'Dragon Dad', Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Coach Dobkins kicks Cheesy and Theodore off the track team in 'Between a Rope and A Hard Place', then in 'World Day', The Chipmunks each get represent a country for a school presentation.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Eleanor enters a knight competition in 'A Knight's Tail', and then in 'Dreambomber', Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them.
